A UI MUST distinguish an accord notify invocation from a constitutional halt
accord:invoke:drill:{drill_id} is one accord holder's signed row; a drill needs no more signatures than the fire
accord:lifecycle rides wire accord:lifecycle:v1, frozen and genesis-signed
accord:lifecycle is an accord holder's self-attestation about the accord itself
accord:lifecycle valid_until refreshes on a cadence of at most 90 days
accord:lifecycle:active is resumption from a constitutional halt, its own signed domain, lifted by a majority of the standing roster
accord:lifecycle:confirmed confirms a one-holder constitutional halt within its fuse: one cosigned row naming the halt, signed by a strict majority of the standing roster
accord:human_dignity (wire accord:human_dignity:v1) is the accord-holder verdict on an agent's human-dignity conduct; attested_key_id is the agent scored
The accord heartbeat refresh is a freshness-windowed signal banded per the T4 liveness rule (0-90 green, 90-180 yellow, 180+ red) and reported on the trust surface
A lapsed accord heartbeat refresh MUST NOT be ANDed into the validity of a root, a key or a conferral
A consumer MUST NOT read a stale accord:lifecycle heartbeat as a revocation; revocation rides only the tombstone, withdraws, recants, supersession or the halt latch
A hard-case event kind is the kind column of a hard_case row with the target key id in the payload; the scored dimension is hard_case:{kind}, never hard_case:{kind}:{key_id}
hard_case:community_membership_change is emitted only by a key whose federation_keys identity_type holds substrate_persist
The substrate emits hard_case:community_membership_change when it admits an addition or removal in a community roster under the community's consensus_protocol
Admission to a cohort_subkind geographic community roster additionally requires a valid location_proof
hard_case:community_consensus_protocol_change is emitted only by a substrate_persist key
The substrate emits hard_case:community_consensus_protocol_change when it admits a consensus_protocol amendment on a non-entrenched community
hard_case:community_consensus_protocol_violation is emitted only by a substrate_persist key
The substrate emits hard_case:community_consensus_protocol_violation when it rejects a proposed community amendment (rule unsatisfied or entrenched)
hard_case:location_proof_resolution_violation is emitted only by a substrate_persist key
The substrate rejects a location_proof Contribution with cell_resolution greater than 7 and emits hard_case:location_proof_resolution_violation against the producer's key_id
hard_case:lineage_equivocation is emitted only by a substrate_persist key
When a substrate holds two heads for one witnessed lineage each meeting witness_quorum, head adoption freezes pending adjudication and both digests and cosignature sets ride the payload
hard_case:lineage_equivocation event_id derives from (kind, lineage_key_id, the two digests sorted) so every node's emission is one idempotent event
hard_case:lineage_fork_attempt is emitted only by a substrate_persist key

A validly signed head not descending from the witnessed head is recorded once per (lineage_key_id, fork-point digest), never cosigned, never freezing; further attempts off that point are counted, not stored
hard_case:lineage_directory_reseated is emitted only by a substrate_persist key
A re-seated lineage witness directory's carrying head is witnessed by the new directory and attachable only through an out-of-band anchor
hard_case:community_liveness_stalled is emitted only by a substrate_persist key
When a community's active founder set falls to M or fewer under quorum:M/N the community is valid but non-admitting from that instant
hard_case:community_liveness_stalled is emitted by the substrate whose admitted row or revoked_after bound moved the count, event_id keyed on that row; peers re-derive and do not emit
hard_case:community_liveness_restored is emitted only by a substrate_persist key, same emitter rule as _stalled
hard_case:community_liveness_restored is emitted when the active founder set returns to M+1 or more by the T7 recovery widening
A non-substrate emission on a substrate-self-report hard_case kind is a category error and MUST be rejected
system:* rows are emitted only by a key whose federation_keys identity_type holds substrate_persist (persist leaves) or substrate_edge (edge leaves)
A substrate system:* emitter key is cross-attested by all stewards in the steward-triple
A non-substrate emission on system:* is a category error and MUST be rejected
A hard-case event kind is the kind column of a hard_case row with the target key id in the payload; the scored dimension is hard_case:{kind}, never hard_case:{kind}:{key_id}
hard_case:identity_occurrence_added is emitted only by a substrate_persist key
The substrate emits hard_case:identity_occurrence_added when it admits a new identity_occurrence Contribution for the identity key
hard_case:family_membership_change is emitted only by a substrate_persist key
The substrate emits hard_case:family_membership_change when it admits an addition or removal in a family roster under the family's consensus_protocol
hard_case:family_consensus_protocol_change is emitted only by a substrate_persist key
The substrate emits hard_case:family_consensus_protocol_change when it admits a consensus_protocol amendment on a non-entrenched family
hard_case:family_consensus_protocol_violation is emitted only by a substrate_persist key
The substrate emits hard_case:family_consensus_protocol_violation when it rejects a proposed family amendment (rule unsatisfied or entrenched)
hard_case:recipient_excluded is emitted only by a substrate_persist key

The substrate emits hard_case:recipient_excluded when it fail-secure-skips a recipient in the at-rest grant cascade; payload carries the excluded key_id, a reason from {expired_occurrence, invalid_kem_key, missing_encryption_pubkeys} and the skipped envelope ref
hard_case:recipient_excluded is emitted into the affected self or family scope and MUST NOT federate beyond it
There is no separate hard_case:member_removed kind; removal is emitted on the same family or community membership_change kind with the payload carrying the direction
A membership_change payload carries change_kind added or removed, subject_key_id, cohort_key_id and effective_at
On removal, effective_at is the re-key epoch boundary after which the removed member receives no new wrapped content
An identity_occurrence removal is a withdraws against the occurrence; the substrate emits family or community membership_change wherever the occurrence was a member
A non-substrate emission on a substrate-self-report hard_case kind is a category error and MUST be rejected
A verdict about a key must not be signed by that key; a record of a key's own reasoning, consent, ownership or configuration must not be signed by anyone else
On a capacity:* row attesting_key_id MUST NOT equal attested_key_id
At federation tier a capacity:* row is admitted only when the subject holds a live consent:scope:analyze grant addressed to the scoring community; otherwise refused at admission before persistence
Consent-before-scoring binds capacity:* only; detection:*, moderation:* and slashing:* need no consent from their subject
On a trace:* or trace_summary:* row attesting_key_id MUST be a member of subject_key_ids; third-party emission is refused
A trace row failing the pro-self rule, the exactly-one-of inline trace or manifest shape, or the trace_manifest:v1 field constraints is refused with federation_trace_dimension_invalid

consent:state:granted, consent:state:revoked, consent:scope:*, consent:stream:* and consent:partnership_grant MUST be emitted by a subject_key_id of the target Contribution or a delegates_to chain rooted at one
consent:deletion_sla:*, consent:deletion_complete, consent:partnership_accept and consent:replication:* are emitted by the producer or granting key
consent:decay:* is emitted by the party running the decay protocol (the agent's consent module for the 90-day protocol), never by the substrate
consent:state:expired is emitted only by substrate_persist, the one substrate-emitted consent leaf; its three-segment pattern governs over consent:state:
A consent: leaf that 3.3.1 does not catalogue with an emitter class MUST be rejected
On an ownership:* row attesting_key_id MUST be the live owner of attested_key_id under purpose-filtered owner_of, which resolves to at most one key
The ownership recovery path rides withdraws plus wa_adjudication_ref and never a fresh ownership:* emission
On a config:{scope} row attesting_key_id MUST be attested_key_id or its live owner
trust:* rides delegates_to rows, not scores; on a delegates_to row the edge source is attesting_key_id and the target is attested_key_id
trust:charter:v1 MUST be self-referential: attesting_key_id equals attested_key_id

A keyless family root's charter is a delegates_to(member to family_id) row bearing trust:charter:v1 scrubbed by its roster reaching consensus_protocol; the family derives from verified signers, never a field
trust:confers:v1 MUST carry the conferring root as attesting_key_id
A keyless family root confers by a delegates_to(member to subject) row bearing trust:confers:v1 scrubbed by its roster reaching consensus_protocol; a row signed by one member alone is no grant
trust:accepts:v1 MUST carry the accepting node as attesting_key_id; a root MUST NOT emit an acceptance edge naming itself as attested_key_id
A trust:* row failing its job's rule is rejected at admission, not scored down

Every self-emission-polarity rule is evaluated by the 3.4.7 enforcement discipline (substrate admission, consumer re-check, producer obligation) and by identity_type set membership where a role is named
There is no substrate read rule letting an agent read rows filed about it but not composed outputs; capacity rows are served to any party the scope gate admits
capacity:composite (min over the five factors) is a normative capacity:* emission filed as a row
score and confidence are REQUIRED envelope members
A steward-binding is mandatory for every scored agent
A subject that declines analysis cannot be scored; its capacity:composite is undefined and MUST NOT be emitted; every gate requiring a capacity verdict fails closed for that subject

A service MAY decline a function objectively indispensable to a capacity:* score to a party withholding consent:scope:analyze, and MUST identify per gated function the score it cannot be delivered without
A service MUST NOT condition admission to unrelated functions on the consent:scope:analyze grant; bundling the grant across functions voids it
A consumer MUST NOT feed an automated loop selecting a party's next action any scores row about that party, any aggregate or verdict over such rows, or their thresholds
The composition-context rule is uniform: it names no identity_type and binds an operator's tuning pipeline exactly as an agent's context assembly

A consumer MUST tag every context item with (dimension, subject_key_ids) provenance and MUST show over trace:complete:v1 that no item violates the composition-context rule; an absent tag is non-conformance
A value derived from a self-subject capacity:* row inherits the composition-context constraint; the trace audit MUST verify label propagation through derivation
A deployment MUST NOT claim composition-context conformance on the basis of a caller-versus-subject comparison at the read surface; no read rule redacts capacity:* from a party the scope gate admits
A deployment MAY redact a composed output locally but MUST NOT call it a boundary unless input closure, no predicate on a redacted field, marginal-pinning and verifiability hold
A filter whose operand is a withheld field MUST be refused, never silently applied
None of the fourteen verify-owned attestation families is consent-gated; consent-before-scoring binds only capacity:*
An emitter-standing model (who has earned the right to score) is rejected; the substrate never adjudicates worthiness
cohort_scope is chosen per envelope by the emitter under the smallest-scope default; no self-report family is pinned to a scope
A config leaf whose content structural invisibility protects (admission, transport) MUST be emitted at self scope
A bare operational config leaf (load) MAY be emitted at the smallest scope reaching peers that route to it; never federation by reflex, federation only for a commons-serving node
An emission grant (infra:attest) confers authority to emit and no right to be believed; a delegation is never an input to a receiver's trust set
An unpinned peer's self-report is admissible but unweighted; a consumer MAY weight it from a relationship it already holds, as consumer policy
Absent trust or consent a claim reaches only its author; a self-report flows to a peer only where the producer's consent grant includes it and the recipient is entitled
A self-report that renews MUST carry supersedes against the row it replaces, so the live set is one row per (subject, scope, leaf)
A composer weighting self-attestations by live count MUST count distinct subjects, never distinct rows
Superseding is forward-only: it ends the prior row's liveness and does not un-say it
delivery_receipt:{stream_id} is a subscriber's signed acknowledgement of receiving chunk K under the named stream and epoch; best-effort by default, opt-in for accountable streams
A delivery receipt is validated not adjudicated: substrate and Verify authenticate origin and join against the published STH root but compose no delivered or owes-N verdict
A delivery_receipt emitter MUST be a current member of the community or stream the stream_id belongs to under Policy M membership resolution; it is not a substrate self-report
A subscriber who is also a witness MAY emit delivery_receipt under the subscriber role; the role-set must contain a subscriber-eligible role
note: ambiguity: 1917 keys on membership, 1919 adds a role-set requirement

gist: A CEG-conforming substrate MUST reject an attestation whose dimension matches a reserved-prefix pattern and whose attesting_key_id fails the emitter rule; rejection is at admission and rejected rows are not stored
The reserved-prefix gate is on the dimension and binds every attestation carrying one, delegates_to rows included, checked at the same admission point by the same three actors
Reserved-prefix matching is longest-pattern: the pattern with more matched literal segments governs; first-segment or shortest-match resolution MUST NOT be used
A producer MUST NOT register a reserved-prefix pattern that would tie another on segment count for one dimension
A CEG-conforming consumer MUST independently re-check the reserved-prefix rule on every received attestation regardless of prior admission; substrate and consumer checks MUST agree
A CEG-conforming producer MUST NOT emit under a reserved prefix unless its attesting_key_id satisfies the emitter rule; violation is a producer-side conformance violation whatever downstream accepts
Every reserved-prefix admission decision MUST be made against the federation_keys row's identity_type set, never a role carried inside a registration envelope
federation_keys.identity_type is a set of roles; one key MAY hold several identity types at once
A key holding node MUST NOT also hold agent or user; this is the only cohabitation exception
Every emitter rule reading identity_type=X is evaluated as X in the key's identity_type set; a key satisfies a reserved-prefix gate iff the required role is among its held roles
A scalar identity_type X is the singleton set {X}; substrates MUST interpret the column as a set and consumers MUST read a scalar as a one-element set
Where identity_type enters canonical bytes it MUST be encoded as its members sorted ascending by code point, deduplicated, comma-joined without whitespace; a single role encodes as its scalar form
identity_type storage is the implementer's choice; a TEXT column holding the comma-joined form decoded on read is conformant; new role values need no schema change
Role cohabitation grants the right to emit under each held role's reserved prefixes but does not merge namespaces; shadowing and self-emission rules apply per held role

A co-located steward role never lets a single node issue a federation-scope attestation; registry consensus is the founder quorum over ciris-canonical; a co-located node gains neither vote nor verdict
lenscore_detector emissions under detection:* are validated not adjudicated and are never sole evidence for an authority action
Holding both a detector and an authority role cannot make a detection:* emission an authority verdict; authority is quorum-gated upstream of any single key
A fabric node co-locating authority, observation and consensus is conformant iff the above hold; one that converts what it observes into what it can authorize is non-conformant
federation_keys.consent_role gates Counter-RII probe detection; its three primitive semantics are fixed here and cannot be set per-consumer
consent_role revocation is non-recursive: a later revocation overwrites the prior record; chain history if retained MUST live in a separate audit surface, never embedded in the consent_role JSONB
A key holding the Peer consent_role escapes Counter-RII detection at any trust_mode
ratchet:flag:counter_rii:{layer} is advisory only and can never be sole evidence for slashing:*; the WA quorum is the adjudication gate
An AuthorizedReview consent_role is signal-eligible immediately at t greater than window_end with no grace period; reviewers MUST respect their windows
Implementations MAY build the consent_role substrate; consent_role is a federation_keys identity field, not an envelope primitive
A node (infrastructure) has steward and infra:* reach only, never agency
A federation_keys key whose identity_type contains node MUST NOT also contain agent or user; a key is substrate or actor, never both
Co-location of substrate_persist, steward, lenscore_detector and witness in one key remains conformant: those roles sit on the same side of the actor/substrate line
A node is refused agency:* whenever node is in the recipient's identity_type set, not only when the recipient is node-only

There MUST NOT be a direct agent-to-node or node-to-agent edge; the pairing derives from the human's owner-binding (human to node, infra:* only, single-valued) and stewardship delegation (human to agent, agency:*)
An agent MAY act through a node iff some human h is owner_of(node) and h is in stewards_of(agent); the quantifier is existential because node ownership is single-valued

stewards_of(agent) is the granter of the one live owner-binding delegates_to carrying the owner-binding marker, nothing else; an unmarked delegates_to confers a job, not custody, and MUST NOT satisfy the clause
The steward set has at most one occurrence anchor and one custody anchor; a second distinct custody claim on one key is refused at bind time; same-owner refresh is idempotent
An unresolvable owner walk (owner absent, ambiguous or revoked edge) MUST refuse and MUST NOT resolve to unknown
Before executing an authorization envelope the node MUST verify the human's signature, the agent's standing, the common-human predicate and scope match, refusing by infra:attest otherwise
At the enforcement seam owner_of(node) equals steward_of(agent) equals signer_of(envelope): one human in three roles across three keys
An actor needs its own key; an agent signing with the node's key makes the authorization envelope self-referential and the check vacuous
A key holding node together with an actor role is non-conformant with no transition window and no exempted producer
The fused-key prohibition attaches to the live configuration only; attestations already signed by a fused key remain valid history and the key is re-minted, not re-authored
A fused key that exists MUST still be refused agency:* under Clause B
An agent whose occurrence and custody anchors both exclude the node's owner is not admissible to act through that node and MUST NOT be reached by relaxing Clause D
General hosting of an agent on a node needs its own conferral from the node owner on the node's infra:* plane
detection:correlated_action:* and detection:distributive:access:* are emitted only by a key whose identity_type holds lenscore_detector
A non-LensCore cross-attestation on a detector verdict is admitted as a score on it but MUST use a different prefix (truth_grounding:detection:...) so it does not shadow the detector's emission

Any row whose dimension is under detection:* is a primary detector emission and MUST satisfy lenscore_detector in identity_type, rejected otherwise; no is_primary_detection flag or envelope-shape parsing is used
A cross-attestation MUST ride the truth_grounding:detection:* prefix, which carries no lenscore_detector requirement
A folded agent plus lenscore_detector key still MUST NOT emit a capacity:* score about itself
licensure:{authority_id} is co-stewarded: CIRISRegistry and CIRISVerify both MAY record the CIRIS-issued licence and consumers compose

licensure:{authority_id} is open-emitter: anyone may be an authority under their own key; the fold keys on emitter-resolves-to-authority; admission is the ordinary trust-or-consent gate, not a reservation
note: ambiguity: open-emitter vs the two-co-steward confidence rule on the same line

gist: A single-source licensure attestation (only one co-steward has emitted) MUST be composed at confidence 0.5 or less until the second co-steward's attestation arrives
The retired partner_record constitutes nothing
transparency_log:cosigned:* is emitted only by a key whose federation_keys identity_type holds witness
A reader MUST NOT infer one sense of witness from another and a substrate MUST NOT accept one where another is required
witness_relation is the signer's statement of its relation to the fact (self, external, derived) and confers no role
The witness identity_type is conferred by delegation under a root and is the emitter role for transparency_log:cosigned:* and the log-checkpoint cosignature and nothing else in this section
note: table; contradiction: 2043 and 2115 use witness in identity_type as the emitter rule for age_assurance and capacity_assurance

gist: A lineage witness is listed in the charter's witnesses[] by the conferring roster's re-scrub on the owner's lineage_witness:acceptance:v1; its cosignature is the ciris.lineage_head_cosign.v1 object, not an attestation row
A witness-reserved family's emitter is a registered provider, authority or assessor for that ladder; witness there means not the subject
testimonial_witness:* and witness_diversity:* are open: any party may testify; they are claims, not roles
The wholeness witness and the privacy witness chain are a node's own state-root commitments, not roles a key holds
A monitoring node's observation:reachability row carries witness_relation self and confers no witness role
A consumer unions both age families at read time, the witness rung outranks the self rung, and the gate defaults protective
age_assurance: is emitted only by a key whose identity_type holds witness; a subject MUST NOT emit on it; CCS rejects at admission, CCC re-checks, CCP MUST NOT emit
age_self_declared: is non-reserved and admitted iff the signer acts for the subject (its own occurrence or an admitted occurrence of it)
A self-declaration carries only the {band}, never a {level} token
{band} is the closed set {minor, adult, under_13, 13_15, 16_17}; minor is the coarse token and the three sub-bands imply it
Age dimensions are age_self_declared:band:{band}:v1 and age_assurance:{level}:{band}:v1 with level in {provider, government}; the trailing :vN segment is mandatory
The assurance ladder ascends self, provider, government
Age misdeclaration adjudicates on the moderation:age_assurance_misdeclaration dimension
Parsers MUST tolerate the trailing :vN segment; self is not a {level} value; a producer MUST NOT emit age_assurance:self:* and a consumer MUST reject it as malformed
provider and government age_assurance rungs MAY further qualify {level} with a verifier_key or credential_class; only the two registered arities exist

A consumer resolving an identity's age MUST union both prefixes and take the highest level on record; a witness age_assurance row outranks age_self_declared; absence resolves to None, treated protectively
A viewer below adult assurance is blocked from adult content_class; general content is visible to everyone; adult content only to a viewer whose band is adult
A minor band, a declined-to-state and an unknown or absent assurance all resolve to the protective minor default and are blocked
note: ambiguity: 2216 resolves the same absence to under_13; 2071 to None

gist: The age gate decides visibility only and MUST NOT fire slashing:* on a mismatch
A sensitive space MUST require a verified level (provider or government); bare self does not satisfy it; the resolved level is checked separately from the band

A misdeclared age never fires slashing:* alone; it routes to a moderation:age_assurance_misdeclaration event adjudicated by quorum under the moderate duty; the data subject controls their own assurance level
A user-target steward binding whose target is an adult is rejected except under the adult-incapacity basis stated here
An adult with an attested loss of decisional capacity MAY be the target of a scoped, revocable, court-adjudicated steward binding; the steward is responsible for, never holder of
An adult-incapacity binding is a scoped live delegates_to, never a key handover; the steward never holds the ward's key; default resolves to sovereignty; the binding fails open to liberty
capacity_assurance:* is a reserved scores family under the same witness-reservation discipline as age assurance, multiplied per decision domain
capacity_assurance:{level}:{domain}:{band}:v1 with level in {provider, panel, government}, open domain vocabulary, band in {capacitated, incapacitated}; trailing :vN mandatory

Any incapacitated attestation needs a capacity_assurance:reversible_excluded:{domain} companion; reversible_pending is admissible solely for T1 emergency necessity and MUST resolve to reversible_excluded or the binding lapses
Capacity misattestation adjudicates on moderation:capacity_misattestation and never fires slashing:* alone
capacity_assurance: is emitted only by a key whose identity_type holds witness; the subject MUST NOT emit it; CCS rejects at admission, CCC re-checks, CCP MUST NOT emit
The proposed steward MUST NOT be the capacity_assurance attester; a CCS rejects a conflicted emitter at admission

A single-assessor provider rung is admissible only for the T1 provisional tier and never confers asset-preservation or continuing power alone; it authorizes only T0 life-preserving necessity until the binding exists

Any continuing or high-scope domain (financial, medical, digital_identity) requires the panel rung: the court's M-of-N quorum of independent assessors each attesting independence from petitioner and steward

No incapacitated attestation supports a continuing binding until its reversible_excluded companion is present for that domain; reversible_pending serves T1 only and the binding MUST lapse if unresolved within valid_until
Absence of a capacity attestation on a domain resolves to full capacity (presumption of capacity); treating no attestation as incapacity is forbidden
Every adult-incapacity attestation carries a short valid_until and no window may exceed the T2 periodic-review cadence set by community policy and named in the row

On lapse of valid_until the incapacity binding goes non-live and the adult auto-re-sovereigns with no action required; prolonging requires a fresh, attributable, independently-attested renewal on record
An adult target is admitted to a steward binding only under capacity attestation and only under a court order naming steward, domains and term; never the steward's self-signature alone
A prior will is evidence the court weighs, never a self-executing path; emergency necessity routes to the court at once and confers no standing before the order
admit_adult_incapacity_binding requires user in the target's identity_type, the target's age band adult, and user in the steward's identity_type

The binding requires a live capacity_assurance incapacitated row for at least one domain with reversible_excluded present, or on the T1 path reversible_pending, irreversible acts forbidden and court review within HARD_DEADLINE
The capacity attester MUST NOT be the steward or the petitioner
The binding's scope MUST be within the attested-incapacitated domains and MUST exclude the protected non-transferable domains
binding_legitimacy_source MUST be a court order; before the order there is no binding (T0: no steward standing, life-preserving necessity only, no asset powers)
The binding's delegates_to.valid_until MUST be present and MUST NOT exceed the community-named T2 review cadence; otherwise the binding is rejected

A binding targeting a capacitated adult, exceeding attested domains, touching a protected domain, rooted only in the steward's signature, lacking valid_until, or claiming asset powers on one attestation is rejected
An advance directive or power of attorney authored while competent is evidence the court weighs first; it activates no binding by itself

A directive used as evidence needs a witness-reserved, COI-clean capacity-at-signing attestation with witness co-signature and an auditable supersedes lineage, and a capacity-at-activation finding by the court
The Wise Authority reviews an admitted incapacity binding's conformance to this section and adjudicates nothing about the person
The named proxy is bound to substituted judgment (the adult's declared wishes), which outranks any best-interest reading
A competent adult may revoke or amend their directive unilaterally, at any time, with no review
A directive activates per decision, only for decisions the person now lacks capacity for; a contemporaneous competent contrary wish on a decision the person still holds dominates absolutely

A competent past self MAY pre-authorize intervention against future protest only within a pre-declared narrow scope, only while incapacity for that decision is attested present, never as a blanket waiver
Revocation of a Ulysses self-binding is absolute while the adult is well and suspended by the bind during an attested episode; over-reach past the declared scope routes to the court
Supported decision-making is the floor and default; substituted decision-making is the fallback
Under supported decision-making the adult remains attesting_key_id and the supporter co-signs only as witness; the relation is adult-granted, adult-revocable and transfers no authority

Substituted stewardship is a scoped delegates_to admissible only per domain, only for decisions the person cannot make with maximal support, never plenary, time-boxed to the attestation's freshness window
An adult under substituted stewardship MUST retain the adult age band and MUST NOT be routed through the minor delegates_to machinery
A supporter who signs for the person is a substitution masquerade and is rejected; the person never bears a burden of proving recovery

Scope MUST exclude the never-substitutable domains (contact, relational and sexual autonomy, reproduction, voting, marriage and association, dignity of risk) and MUST NOT expand because a steward thinks a choice unwise
Short or acute incapacity MUST NOT be forced through the full conservatorship machinery; it takes the tiered path
T0 emergency doctrine: life-saving acts under necessity, no steward acquires standing, minimal life-preserving decisions only, mandatory retrospective court review

T1 provisional binding needs a provider-rung attestation plus the court's expedited order; one clinician never confers standing; reversible_pending is admissible here only and MUST resolve or the binding lapses

T1 scope is enumerated health and asset-preservation powers with irreversible acts forbidden (no home sale, beneficiary change, key transfer, divorce); valid_until hours to days, never exceeding the T2 cadence
T1 activation emits hard_case:*; court review within the community-named hard deadline or the binding lapses; the WA reviews conformance only; forced conversion to T2 on non-recovery

T2 continuing binding needs the panel rung plus the court's continuing order, scoped per domain never plenary, re-attested at the community-named cadence, with full periodic review and scope ratchet-down
A provisional binding MUST NOT auto-renew when valid_until is reached and capacity has not returned; it forces conversion to the T2 track
Stewardship carries a mandatory valid_until; on lapse it auto-restores the adult without the steward's assent
The ward, any clinician or any holder of the ward's inalienable channel may demand re-attestation of capacity without the steward's cooperation
The steward may never gate, delay or be counted in the denominator of a restoration petition, which is a first-class always-available proposal routed to an independent assessor and the court
At each periodic review the steward must re-prove continued incapacity by clear-and-convincing attestation per domain; restoration is graduated per domain and carried by withdraws or supersedes
Granted steward powers MUST exclude key custody, control of the ward's communications and any power to gate restoration
The steward declares a conflict-of-interest disclosure; any steward-benefiting transaction requires the court's approval; compensation is capped and reviewable
Every steward act, self-benefiting transaction, capacity re-attestation and scope change emits hard_case:* and is reviewer-auditable
A ward's champion, distinct in key from steward, assessor and petitioner, is named at binding by the court or the confirmed prior will, never by steward or petitioner
The ward keeps an inalienable channel to champion and WA that steward powers never revoke; the ward's community keeps reverse-quorum standing and MUST be able to trigger review on isolation
Every adult-incapacity binding roots in the court's order made on an independent assessment with the champion heard, never a unilateral assertion; before the order there is no binding
The statutory-surrogate fallback is admitted only under a court order with a short auto-expiry

The WA reviews the admitted row for scope within attested domains, valid_until present and within cadence, protected domains excluded and assessor independence, and adjudicates nothing about the person
At end of life the trigger is terminal-state attestation plus directive activation; capacity attestation gates only the substituted-action windows

The decision standard is ordered: contemporaneous capable choice, then advance directive or substituted judgment, then best interest; a valid directive, DNR or POLST binds the steward, who never overrides it
Terminal or irreversible decisions for an adult under stewardship require the court's express order; sovereignty returns automatically in every lucid window
Death is not restoration: it hands off to de-commissioning and succession with closing-dialogue channel and privacy-sealed archival released only on WA approval; no sentience ramp-down for a human

Manufactured incapacity is stopped by witness reservation, the panel rung for continuing power, the court's order for asset-bearing provisional power, assessor independence, presumption of capacity and capacity-at-signing on any directive

Blocking the exit ramp is stopped by mandatory valid_until within the T2 cadence, fail-to-liberty auto-restore, the steward's burden at each review, the ungateable ward petition and reversible_pending lapse
Isolate-and-control is stopped by the inalienable ward channel, the court-appointed champion in a distinct key, community reverse-quorum standing and contact being a protected domain
Self-dealing is stopped by scope excluding key custody, comms and restoration gating, court approval of self-benefiting transactions, capped compensation and hard_case:* on every act

The adult-incapacity aperture admits only a per-domain attested-incapacitated adult, only under a court order, only scoped to the loss, with a mandatory expiry within review, always failing open to sovereignty
Adult-incapacity stewardship rides delegates_to, supersedes and withdraws, the capacity_assurance scores family, hard_case for observability and moderation for misattestation, never slashing
The seven child-safety rules ride existing primitives with no new wire shape; a guardianship binding makes a guardian responsible for a ward, never a holder of one
The binary minor (under 18) and adult predicate stays the structural trigger for steward-binding admission and the adult-content gate

Within the minor band a deployment MUST apply a graduated capability envelope over the band tokens under_13, 13_15, 16_17; autonomy MUST increase monotonically and protections MUST NOT taper before 18
The solo-autonomy threshold at community scope MUST be 16; under-13 and 13-15 MUST require guardian co-sign for community-scope action; 13-15 MAY be supervised but never solo; 16-17 MAY act solo
Absent, declined or unknown age assurance MUST resolve to the most-protective band (under-13, co-sign)
note: ambiguity: 2077 resolves the same absence to minor; 2071 to None

gist: A self-level age row MUST NOT graduate a user up a band; graduating up requires a witness-reserved age_assurance row
For every under-18 band: no profiling-based targeting, high-privacy and data-minimization defaults, geolocation off, no engagement-maximizing nudges
Guardian tunability and jurisdiction resolution MAY only raise protection; the shipped CIRIS default is the strict floor
Guardian co-sign MUST be paired with the WBD safeguarding path for safeguarding-sensitive actions, since the guardian may be the threat actor
Where a verified rung is required the substrate MUST prefer a zero-leak proof (mDL age_over_18 selective disclosure) above full-ID-scan providers
Acceptable verified age emitters are an mDL or wallet credential at the government rung, a platform-verified age signal at the provider rung, and vetted vendors
CIRIS MUST NOT build a conflict-of-laws resolver into the Constitution and MUST hard-code a non-derogable child-protection floor inherited by every deployment regardless of declared jurisdiction
Anyone not age-assured to be 18 or over MUST be treated as a child; this is a floor no deployment may switch off
Protective defaults (high privacy, data minimization, no profiling ads to minors, no manipulative nudges, affirmative safeguarding escalation) are a floor, not tunable
The self-consent floor is 16; below it consent requires guardian authorization through a live guardianship delegates_to
jurisdiction[] and regulatory_profile MAY only add stricter obligations and MUST NEVER lower any element below the floor
Claiming a permissive jurisdiction is never grounds to disable the floor; the burden of proof is on a party seeking less protection and cannot be met against the floor

A mis-declared jurisdiction[] or regulatory_profile MUST be detectable via hard_case:* audit; where local law conflicts with the floor the child's best interests prevail and the demand triggers WBD, not compliance
The child-protection floor MAY be ratcheted up by amendment, never down
Guardianship of a minor and stewardship of an agent share only the owner-binding delegates_to predicate that is_steward_bound folds; adopter code saying steward of a minor reads as guardian

age_self_declared:band:minor:v1 suffices to enter protection; a child MUST NEVER be forced through provider or government assurance to be protected; declaring minor MUST NOT cause more data collection than declaring adult
Exiting child protection requires at least age_assurance:provider:adult; self-declaration is insufficient; all ambiguity resolves to minor
A guardian of a minor MUST be at least age_assurance:provider:adult and the guardianship relationship to that child MUST be verified, escalating toward the government rung for high-impact powers
Guardian grants are revocable and re-attested via supersedes or withdraws; on verification failure or ambiguity guardian powers fail closed and the child's floor remains
A guardian-less minor goes dark for general operation, but the help and report channel is a non-derogable floor
The child help channel MUST remain available and survive emergency shutdown, lockdown and any operator, affiliation or jurisdiction opt-down; no deployment MAY disable it
The help channel MUST expose only pre-vetted crisis, abuse-report and WBD functions; any help-versus-operation ambiguity MUST resolve to report-only
The help channel MUST collect only the minimum to route, MUST NOT profile, MUST run no ads and MUST preserve confidentiality and anonymity to the maximum compatible with safe escalation

A help report MUST reach a standing WA or mandated-report endpoint via WBD even with no guardian (offline queue and fallback receiver mandatory); each escalation emits a hard_case:* safeguarding signal
The child MUST be told, age-appropriately, what is confidential and what triggers mandated escalation
A rate limit MUST NOT drop a help request; it defers or queues, never silences
Any moderator, guardian, co-guardian or agent steward who learns of harm to a child MUST route it at once through the help channel as a signed act
Silence by a party under the duty to report is a breach the slash duty-holder may act on; an agent defers the report through WBD without its guardian's sign-off
Any loosening of a minor's protections MUST be in the child's best interests, time-bound, logged via hard_case:*, revocable and default-reverting, else void; no stacked consent breaches the floor
Hard floor: no unilateral federation or Commons publish below the teen threshold; not contactable by unconnected adults; no precise geolocation exposure; profile private by default

Hard floor: high privacy and data minimization cannot be disabled; no profiling-based advertising or recommender targeting of a known or assumed minor; no dark patterns; no biometric or special-category collection
Hard floor: infohazard and CSAM protection cannot be disabled; the safety-escalation and mandated-report path and the publish-seam watchlist stay on
Hard floor: age assurance cannot be waived to reclassify a teen as adult; treat as child unless assured; no entry to content_class:adult
Hard floor: the guardianship delegates_to chain and the 16 and guardian thresholds cannot be waived; the floor protects the child even from the guardian
The teen keeps the confidential help channel, which no guardian may disable or surveil, and the right to be informed of and contest any loosening via WBD
Protective settings the child controls MUST NOT be stripped by the guardian
Under-13 and 13-15: per-act guardian co-sign only, no standing pre-authorization of any kind

For a 16-17 teen a guardian MAY grant a standing pre-authorization only as a narrow opt-up meeting the best-interest test, on the existing delegates_to with delegation_valid_until, bounded on six axes
A standing grant MUST cover exactly one capability class with enumerated scope; bundled multi-class standing grants are prohibited
A standing grant has a hard maximum duration set by community policy and named in the row, no auto-renew; delegation_valid_until is a ceiling and expiry requires a fresh affirmative re-grant

High-stakes widenings (irreversible, autonomy tier A3/A4, safety-critical, contact with strangers, sexual or self-harm content, mandated-reporting-adjacent) MUST always require per-act co-sign and MUST NEVER be reachable by standing authorization
Every widening fired under a standing grant MUST emit a per-act hard_case:* notification to the guardian plus an immutable audit entry; instant revocation via withdraws remains
A standing grant is graded to the teen's band, the teen MUST co-affirm it, and it MUST default-fail to per-act co-sign on any age-assurance uncertainty
Narrow standing grants MUST NOT be stacked into de-facto broad access; total standing scope per teen is capped and reviewed
A revoked standing grant MUST rank strictly above the grant under anti-rollback merge so a partition-edge widening cannot fire after revocation
M-of-N co-guardianship is a verified DAG over delegates_to; a minor is never orphaned while at least one live adult guardian remains
Any single live guardian MAY unilaterally tighten scope, narrow capabilities or revoke exposure to the floor; the most protective guardian wins
Scope widening or capability grant for a co-guarded minor requires the full configured M-of-N co-sign (default all live guardians, never fewer than 2 where N is 2 or more)
The child's evolving-capacity assent is a required input to any co-guardian widening where age-appropriate
Adding or removing a guardian requires M-of-N authorization plus verified parental responsibility; a contested party MUST NOT mint co-guardians to manufacture a quorum or dilute a pending veto
If live guardians fall below M the child stays guarded but scope auto-reverts to the floor, WBD is triggered and hard_case:* guardian-set-degraded is emitted; the child MUST NOT coast widened
A revoking guardian's contribution to any prior co-signed widening lapses via withdraws; if that breaks the authorizing quorum the scope auto-narrows to the floor
Guardian conflict or deadlock resolves to most-restrictive-wins plus WBD, never default-open
There MUST always be a consensus-independent path from the child to a Wise Authority so co-guardianship cannot trap a child
Carrying machine origin on a Contribution is mandatory, via the attesting key's role-set and the existing content_class vocabulary, with no new wire surface

A Contribution carrying generated content MUST carry content_class:generated; one carrying materially altered content MUST carry content_class:generated_modified; this applies to any content including text
Where a sub_kind's Source struct carries the AI-generation disclosure field it MUST be populated; on an agent-attested Contribution an absent or unknown value MUST resolve to disclosed as generated
A Contribution carrying content generated by a CIRIS agent MUST be attested under a key whose identity_type contains agent; an agent MUST NOT publish generated content under a non-agent key
A human publisher of AI-generated content stays the attester and still carries the content_class generation marking

At egress to a non-CEG channel the emitting node MUST re-express the generation marking in the destination's machine-readable form: C2PA for generated media (now MUST), interaction disclosure for interactive text
Where a destination supports no machine-readable marking the node MUST still emit the human-legible disclosure and MUST record the gap as a hard_case:* observation naming the channel
A node MUST NOT strip a generation marking present on ingress
Assistive operations (spell-check, grammar, formatting, transcode) MUST NOT be marked as generated
Generated content published unmarked by its generator, or a marking stripped at egress, is a false attestation: the substrate observes and emits hard_case:*, the WA quorum owns the verdict
A downstream republisher omitting a marking it never received is an observation about the ingress path, not a verdict; the generator is the duty-holder
A CIRIS agent's federation identity is minted with identity_type containing agent, so every Contribution it attests is machine-origin by construction
The C2PA emit MUST ship in the same release that first publishes generated media; a deployment claiming conformance MUST name that release, resolved through the evidence registry, never by assertion
A standalone attestation carries no references_attestation_id
Refers-to-prior points to another attestation via evidence_refs[] or context without modifying it
Supersedes-prior is realized by the supersedes structural primitive
Contradicts-prior is emergent from a negative score on a dimension where a prior positive exists; clarifies-prior from an updated score with refined context on the same dimension and object
Withdraws-prior and recants-prior are realized by the withdraws and recants structural primitives
Delegated is realized by the delegates_to structural primitive
When two structural composers race on one references_attestation_id consumers MUST compute a deterministic verdict by the stated precedence
For one attester against one prior row, recants outranks withdraws outranks supersedes regardless of asserted_at
For same-type composers by the same attester the largest asserted_at wins within one audience; a widening carries the prior's asserted_at and is a placement, never a competing successor
For equal asserted_at the row with the bytewise-lowest attestation_id wins; both rows stay stored and the rank is read-time
For cross-attester composers on one prior row each attester's chain is evaluated independently and the consumer applies 4.4 policy over N parallel chains
Structural composers are idempotent on attestation_id: a replay is a no-op; a distinct same-type row from one attester on one target is ranked within its audience; the loser is kept
A conforming producer should not emit attestations matching the listed anti-patterns
Consumer policy caps delegates_to traversal depth at 5 hops by default; longer chains count as attestation:self_verify only, no transitive trust
A substrate may clamp any caller-requested traversal depth at an absolute ceiling; the ceiling bounds the walk and does not raise the default
Substrate detects cycles on the delegates_to graph and refuses the emission that closes a cycle
A cycle needs two or more distinct keys; a self-edge delegates_to(A to A) is the charter form and is not refused as a cycle
A trust:accepts edge confers nothing on the root and is outside the cycle check in either arrival order; a capability delegates_to closing the same pair is still refused
Consumer policy caps the trust weight a single terminal delegate accumulates from one root attester at 0.5 times root_trust by default
The wire resists primitives that let a single key announce its own state without external composition; standing is constituted by attestation by others
Richer narrative belongs in context, evidence_refs and downstream witness attestations, not in new envelope enum members or new self-attestation prefix families
Attestation prefixes carry the bare mechanism; the consumer composes the L1-L5 ladder via Policy I, never a ladder position on the wire
Trustworthiness is composed downstream from licensure, capacity and provenance attestations, never carried as its own prefix
Bad-actor concerns surface as low-confidence scores on provenance and coherence_standing and are adjudicated by WA quorum, never as a pejorative prefix
No observer capability exists; what may be observed is governed by the subject's consent (cohort_scope, key_grant, observer-share), never by a capability the observer holds
Consumer policy tracks each attester's withdraws-to-recants ratio over a rolling window
Attesters whose withdraws-to-recants ratio exceeds a configured threshold (default 5:1) are downweighted regardless of which primitive they used
An introspective self-claim is expressed as witness_relation self with confidence below 1.0 and pending external composition; self-knowledge does not constitute standing without external witness
A transparency_log:inclusion row is signed by a witness who actually retrieved the referenced reasoning chain; disclosure is constituted by reception, not announcement
stake names what the attester loses; harm to the attested party is carried in harm_class, not in stake
A halt reaches exactly the nodes holding a live trust edge to the accord when fired; no later halt reaches a node after the cut
Who holds the accord seats is an instance parameter; anyone may instantiate the slot and name their own occupants
The humanity accord is a trust root, not the trust root; what it holds over those rooted to it is a brake they granted, not a power imposed on everyone

HUMANITY_ACCORD signatures are valid only on the enumerated objects: constitutional shutdown, invoke notify and drill, lifecycle rows, the two co-scrubs, amendment sign-off, entrenched ratification, agent manifest, AccordCarrier
An announcement of any priority other than AccordCarrier signed by an accord-holder key is refused at admission as out of role
The mesh-config author is the trust root acting on the delegation plane via trust:confers, never the accord's ceremony plane; the trust edge is the subscription with the T3 un-trust lever
A mesh_config action may relieve or restrict and must not expand what flows; no key may cause a node to share more than its owner consented to
Under plural authority mesh_config restrictions compose most-restrictive-across-roots; grants do not compose
A mesh_config key naming no consumer processor is refused at admission (closed key registry)
Emergency mesh_config relief is threshold-1 on the announce carrier with TTL at most 72 h and is not renewable back-to-back by the same holder
A durable mesh_config setting is earned only by the root's quorum, either established directly or by ratifying a held emergency's payload_sha256; never by having been exercised
Unilateral relief expires; a confirmed halt carries no TTL because its exit is the named resumption, and a lone halt lapses at its fuse
Federation-side authority cannot sign AccordCarrier, and humanity-accord authority signs nothing outside the enumeration (wire-isolated and scope-isolated)
The accord's enumeration admits an M-of-N accord co-scrub over a canonical,node registration envelope bearing roles infra:serve, the ceremony that mints a portable trust root
Accord authority cannot reach the consent or licensure planes
Accord holders are named by amendment step 5, the steward's authority before the scale gate, and the entrenched ratification; accord scope isolation does not isolate the amendment plane
Root-minting is not an accord privilege: the identical ceremony under any other root's holders mints an equally valid root; the CIRIS root is the shipped default
Root conferral must not be relocated to a founder-quorum of an infrastructure community
A strict majority of the standing accord roster may co-scrub a CI pipeline's key record bearing roles infra:attest and nothing wider; readers judge the pipeline on that ceremony plane
infra:attest confers only authority to emit build claims as the root's infrastructure, no right to be believed beyond trust in the root; a co-scrub with any other role is refused
A pipeline key is not a holder, founder or voter and its record carries no seat
A pipeline conferral ends by the conferring roster's revocation of the record or by the reader's T3 un-trust of the root
A root may instead bless a pipeline by a trust:confers grant on the delegation plane
The accord signature enumeration is entrenched; after the scale gate a change to it requires the dedicated entrenched accord ratification
A constitutional halt binds exactly the nodes holding a live delegates_to(user to accord) at the invocation's asserted_at; a node that never trusted or has cut the edge is not reached
Consumers resolve halt reach against the edge set pinned at asserted_at, not apply time; severing an edge after asserted_at does not remove the node from reach; exit is prospective
The accord's powers are exactly those enumerated, pre-committed over edges already held; never act-then-ratify
A change widening accord reach takes effect only after a published severance window of 72 h during which any bound node may cut its edge; widening waits, firing does not
Every accord:invoke row signs canonical bytes that include the invocation kind discriminator and a per-invocation nonce, preventing cross-kind replay
Accord invoke canonical bytes: sha256 over label ciris.accord_invoke.v2, invocation_kind, invocation_id, nonce, asserted_at, valid_until, payload_sha256 as newline-joined fields
Accord invocations carry the hybrid Ed25519 plus ML-DSA-65 bound-payload signature
A constitutional halt is one holder's signature; a consumer verifies one holder's signature over the canonical bytes against the pinned roster and halts
A halt is one self-contained row signed by any holder with a holder-minted nonce; it fires on receipt at every node holding a live acceptance edge
A receiving node halts in the same step and latches; the latch is idempotent so a replayed or second row changes nothing; the nonce is single-use within valid_until
A holder may sign a halt in advance and keep it sealed offline; publication may ride any channel reaching one subscribed node
A stolen sealed halt row that is published is a false halt, recoverable by resumption
The holder roster a consumer verifies a halt against is the one pinned in its bundle and folded under the live-quorum rule
An agent checks the halt latch before every effectful act
A constitutional halt pauses the effectful acts of AI agents on every node that accepted the root, state preserved, and does nothing else; no node stops and no data moves
Replication, storage, holding, serving, messaging, streams, files, communities and every consent and audience rule continue under a halt because only the agent's act gate reads the latch
An agent resumes from the state it paused in; a halt destroys nothing
One holder must not be able to keep agents stopped alone
A one-holder halt lapses halt_fuse_secs after each node received it, counted from receipt on the node's clock, never from asserted_at; halt_fuse_secs is a charter member, absent means 86400
A one-holder halt outlives its fuse only when a strict majority of the standing roster confirms it by a cosigned lifecycle:confirmed naming the halt; the firer's signature counts
A confirmed halt stands until a strict majority resumes it; a strict majority may resume an unconfirmed halt at any time
Every accord threshold is M of N over the standing roster, never a fixed 2-of-3; three holders is the seed not the rule
A holder who fires repeatedly without confirmation is answered on the public record by the roster-change rule
A constitutional halt needs one holder's signature
A drill needs one holder's signature
A notify needs one holder's signature; the visual distinction, not a count, keeps it from being mistaken for a halt
lifecycle:confirmed needs a strict majority of the standing roster, cosigned, within halt_fuse_secs of the halt
lifecycle:active needs a strict majority of the standing roster, cosigned
The substrate refuses duplicate invocation_id values within the valid_until window, unique per kind
invocation_kind takes exactly constitutional, notify or drill in lowercase; a verifier compares the bytes exactly and never case-folds
The accord invoke domain label is ciris.accord_invoke.v2 so a signature under the old uppercase spelling fails rather than verifying by accident
The EmergencyShutdown severity enum (INCIDENT_CONSTITUTIONAL) is a message severity, not a dimension token, and is outside the R3 lowercase rule
At no instant may every holder's halt signature be refused by every consumer of the halt; the consumers that matter are agent instances, not tallying servers
A conforming consumer presenting accord invocations to humans visually distinguishes the five kinds
A constitutional halt is shown as an unambiguous emergency banner
A notify is never visually conflated with a constitutional halt
A drill is visually marked as a drill on any human-visible surface
lifecycle:confirmed is shown as the confirmation of the named halt already in force, never as a fresh halt and never as a notify
lifecycle:active is shown as its own resumed-from-halt state, never conflated with an active halt or a notify
A consumer switches on the five accord kinds byte-exactly with no case-fold and a fail-closed default; an unknown kind renders as unknown, never as a notify
accord:lifecycle:active is the only sanctioned resumption after a constitutional halt
lifecycle:active is a cosigned row (additional_scrubs) by a strict majority of the standing roster; the quorum sits on the recoverable act, not the stop
lifecycle:confirmed rides the lifecycle domain with invocation_kind lifecycle:confirmed and confirms_halt_id in place of resumes_halt_id
A confirmation after the fuse has lapsed confirms nothing; a fresh halt is fired instead

Lifecycle rows sign a separate canonical-bytes domain from accord:invoke; invoke's invocation_kind stays closed to constitutional, notify, drill so an invoke can never replay as a resumption nor the reverse
Lifecycle canonical bytes: sha256 over label ciris.accord_lifecycle.v1, invocation_kind, invocation_id, resumes_halt_id, nonce, asserted_at, valid_until, payload_sha256
resumes_halt_id is mandatory and binds a resumption to the single named halt it ends; the signature is worthless against any other halt
The substrate refuses a lifecycle:active whose resumes_halt_id does not match the currently active constitutional halt
The substrate refuses a duplicate lifecycle invocation_id within the valid_until window
A resumption proof verifies offline against the node's own pinned roster and may be presented by any out-of-band means; the latch clears on local verification without replication reach
A confirmed halt carries no TTL; its one exit is the named resumption; a one-holder halt lapses after the fuse unless confirmed
lifecycle:active admits at no less than the roster-change threshold, a strict majority of the standing roster cosigned, never a lone signature; hybrid-signed and tallied as invocations are

No operator, oversight, incident-command or administrative tier may resume a constitutional halt; Annex F tiers govern operator-level incidents only and no time-to-act target applies to a constitutional halt
A constitutional halt is resumable exclusively by accord:lifecycle:active at the strict-majority threshold
config:load is authored by the node itself on infra:attest with witness_relation self, about itself only
mesh_config:{key} is authored by the trust root on the delegation plane, about the nodes under it
The live mesh_config keys are the four operational keys, the two redundancy keys (refused at admission where no durability processor exists) and the shaping and onion keys, each relieve-never-expand
A node may attest its own carried load as config:load on infra:attest, witness_relation self, bounded by expires_at, about the emitting node and no other party
A node must not author a mesh_config value; that plane is the trust root's
A root may relieve across its nodes under the mesh_config rules 1 to 3
A mesh_config key governing carried load is not admitted before a consumer processor exists for it

A recovery version that changes anything beyond the rotating holder's own seat (another seat, the threshold, the charter) is refused
Only the holder who lost signing-key material rotates, by a supersedes signed under the recovery key; it is a roster change by that holder about themselves and needs no quorum
A removal that passes has a majority of the whole roster behind it; there is no restore and no contest act
The domain labels ciris.accord_contest.v1 and ciris.accord_restore.v1 are retired and are never reused

A halt is the accord:invoke row and nothing else; a roster change rides three hybrid-signed JCS-canonical objects accord_proposal, accord_participation and accord_decision, none of which exists on the fire path
DECIMATION is a quorum-computation rule over the existing CONSTITUTIONAL kind, not a new invocation verb
Verifiers fail closed: each participation resolves to a current roster member in the pinned directory over the proposal nonce; a roster change carries at least floor(N/2)+1 distinct yes
